definitions.observation: [category, fr3d_class, label_seq_id_1, label_seq_id_2, rfam_1, rfam_2, unit_id_1, unit_id_2, mapping_check, altlocs]; base pairs and stacking 5'->3' by label_seq_id (class flipped when needed); base-ribose and base-phosphate in BGSU row order: endpoint 1 = base, endpoint 2 = nucleotide whose ribose / phosphate is contacted (never re-ordered); rfam_k = consensus position (match), 'anchor^offset' (insertion) or null (outside the aligned region)

eligibility_codes.E: match residue with coordinates and complete base
eligibility_codes.I: match residue with an incomplete base
eligibility_codes.-: no match residue (deletion or outside the aligned region)

definitions.eligible: chain annotated by FR3D and the category's file retrieved; base pairs and stacking: both positions match residues with coordinates and complete bases; base-ribose: base nucleotide with a complete base and contacted nucleotide with a complete ribose (C1' C2' C3' C4' O4' O2'); base-phosphate: complete base and a complete phosphate (P OP1 OP2 O5') on the contacted nucleotide (model 1)
definitions.sugar_eligibility: per consensus position, ribose completeness (codes as eligibility, I = incomplete ribose)
definitions.phosphate_eligibility: per consensus position, phosphate completeness (codes as eligibility, I = incomplete phosphate, e.g. a 5'-terminal residue without P)
definitions.annotation_gaps: per chain, [start, end] Rfam ranges of >= 15 (and >= 8% of the chain's eligible) consecutive eligible positions without any BGSU annotation (incomplete source annotation); interactions touching them count as annotation unavailable
definitions.pair_id: category:pos_1-pos_2; base pairs and stacking pos_1 < pos_2; base-ribose / base-phosphate pos_1 = base, pos_2 = contacted backbone
definitions.observed: a non-near FR3D interaction of the category between the two positions in an eligible instance; near ('n') classes are counted as near_only
definitions.structure_class: base pairs only: secondary = position pair of the Rfam SS_cons; tertiary = other pair between two different validated structural elements; unclassified = otherwise
definitions.canonical: n_canonical = observed instances annotated cWW with an AU, GC or GU nucleotide pair
definitions.paired: base pairs only: n_paired = observed + near only (an FR3D base pair of any class, true or near, between the two positions in an eligible chain); other categories: n_paired = n_observed (near never counted)
definitions.consensus: base pairs only: both = Rfam SS_cons position pair paired in at least one eligible chain; 2d = SS_cons pair paired in no eligible chain; 3d = observed base pair that is not an SS_cons pair; null for other categories
definitions.near_classes: near-only eligible chains per near FR3D class
definitions.near_basepairs: per chain: available = near base pairs computed by the pinned local fr3d-python run for its entry (near_basepairs.json); unavailable = not computed (near base pairs cannot be observed there)
definitions.observation_source: last observation field: bgsu (BGSU RNA 3D Hub file) or fr3d_local (near base pair, local fr3d-python)

observations_files.content: every intra-chain observation of the chain (definitions.observation)

provenance.source: BGSU RNA 3D Hub FR3D annotations (base pairs, base stacking, base-ribose, base-phosphate)
